name: MCP reference server: Filesystem
description: Reference implementation (npm @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem). Allowed directories come from command-line arguments or MCP Roots; Roots is deprecated in protocol 2026-07-28. Reference/educational, not production-ready.

provenance.notes: npm latest 1.0.0 published 2026-10-11; license 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE'; depends on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.31.0; mcpName io.github.modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem (not found by exact-name lookup in the official registry on 2026-10-16). Supports version.

README: directory access control via args or Roots; server requests roots/list at initialization and replaces allowed directories; fails at initialization when no args and no roots support. Supports transport stdio and auth none. trust_level is a t4c research suggestion, not a security approval: trusted_external = maintained by the vendor whose API it fronts or by a named organisation, with publisher identity checked against the official MCP Registry namespace or the vendor's own docs; it does not make returned content trusted (see note, #35).
